data.text:
Diamond Beverages Pvt. Ltd vs Food Safety Officer on 5 July,
2024
05.07.2024
Sl. No.28
 ss In The High Court At Calcutta
 Civil Appellate Jurisdiction
 Appellate Side
 F.M.A. 964 of 2023 
 With
 Ia No. Can 1 of 2023
 Diamond Beverages Pvt. Ltd.
 Vs
 Food Safety Officer, through Ajay Kumar Gope
 Mr. Harsh Hiroo Gursahani
 Mr. Suhaan Mukerji
 Mr. Sayandeep Pahari
 ... For the appellant
 Mr. Sanajit Kr. Ghosh
 Mrs. Sarda Sha
 ...  For the respondent Two weeks time is granted to the respondent for filing of affidavit-in-opposition as a last chance. 
One week time thereafter is given to the appellant to file affidavit-in-reply, if so desires. We have been informed that interim order was obtaining in this matter since 17.10.2023 for 10 (ten) weeks olr until further orders, when the Court had granted an opportunity to the respondents for filing an affidavit-in-opposition, which till date has not been filed. 
Till next date of hearing or till further order, whichever is earlier, we re-impose the stay of operation of the order dated 12th November, 2021 passed by the adjudicating officer in connection with FSS Case No.3/JM/FSS/MLDT/18. 
Let the matter appear on 26th July, 2024. 
(Madhuresh Prasad, J.) (Supratim Bhattacharya, J.)
